structure: Alaska Social Studies Standards (adopted Dec 2024), single PDF. Front matter (cover, TOC, introduction, guiding principles, 'How to Read the Standards' with anchor-standard tables/definitions and sample standards) is u1-u380. Standards then run in grade bands. K-2 (u382-u965) and 3-5 (u966-u1665): a grade-level theme table (Kindergarten/First/Second or Third/Fourth/Fifth with a theme), then Inquiry Anchor Standards 1-5 (SS.K-2.n.m / SS.3-5.n.m bullets, band-level), then Civics (Anchor Std 6-10), Economics (11-15), Geography (16-20), History (21-25) tables. Each content table has 3 columns: C1 anchor strand label (e.g. 'Civics Anchor Standard 6 Civic and Political Institutions and Systems', split over many cells), C2 Grade-Band Standard (SS.K-2.6.1 / SS.3-5.6.1), C3 Leveled Content Standard cells beginning 'By the end of K/1/2' (or 3/4/5) with grade codes SS.<grade>.<n>.<anchor>.<m>; column headers repeat on every page. Grades 6-8: 'Grade 6 through 8 Inquiry Standards' (SS.6-8.n.m, band 6-8), then Grade 6 Alaska Studies and Geography (Themes 1-4), Grade 7 World History and Geography (Themes 1-4), Grade 8 U.S. History and Civics (Themes 1-8, with Time Period lines); tables have C1 Topic, C2 anchor standard label, C3 bulleted content standards coded SS.<grade>.<theme>.<anchor>.<n>. Grades 9-12 (u2552 on): one band; Inquiry Anchor Standards 1-5 (SS.9-12.n.m, shared, course null) then discipline sections used as courses: Civics, Economics, Geography (tables with C1 anchor label, C2 bulleted 9-12 standards SS.9-12.n.m), Alaska History (SS.AKH.theme.anchor.n, Themes 1-6, time-period table), U.S. History (SS.USH..., Themes 1-7), World History (SS.WH..., Themes 1-6). No examples/teacher notes or literacy standards exist; everything after the front matter is standards except repeated table column-header cells, which are labeled backup.

issues: Table column-header cells repeated at the top of every content table (Anchor Standard / The student / demonstrates an / understanding of... / Leveled Content Standard / Grade-Band Standard / Content Standard / Topic / Therefore, the student is able to... / 9-12 Content Standard) were labeled backup with the table's grade/band/course (e.g. u434-u440, u1718-u1724, u2630-u2635); they are layout furniture, not content. The 'Grade | Theme' header cells of the grade-theme tables (u384-u385, u968-u969) are also backup.

Anchor-standard label cells are split across many cells and pages (e.g. 'Civics Anchor' / 'Standard 6' / 'Civic and Political' / 'Institutions and' / 'Systems'); they were labeled standards with the band (K-2, 3-5) or the grade/course of the table, and are interleaved with leveled cells on continuation pages (the grade-band standard in C2 is repeated at the top of a page when its leveled rows continue).

Leveled cells reading '[standard not addressed at this grade]' (e.g. u473-u474, u482, u485, u539, u551, u569, u1221, u1225, u1242-u1243, u1246-u1247, u1250-u1251, u1643, u1654) were labeled standards with the single grade named in 'By the end of X'; they contain no standard text.

u1155 ('By the end of 4: SS.3.4.8.1') and u1456 ('By the end of 4: SS.3.4.18.1') carry a grade-3 style code but the cell is explicitly 'By the end of 4'; labeled grade 4 per the explicit header text (probable typo in the source).

Row/column text order: in many K-5 tables a grade-band standard (C2) appears on the previous page header repetition after a page break, so leveled cells for grades 4 or 5 may appear on the next page under the repeated C2 text (e.g. u1081, u1237). Grade assignment relies only on 'By the end of X'.

K-2 and 3-5 inquiry standards (u392-u431, u977-u1025) and 6-8 inquiry standards (u1666-u1715) are band-level skills standards; labeled with the full band (K-2, 3-5, 6-8) so they are copied into each grade. 9-12 inquiry (u2552-u2627) labeled course null, grades 9-12.

Grade-level theme tables (u384-u391 K-2; u968-u975 3-5) were split by row: each row's grade name and theme cell labeled with that single grade (K/1/2, 3/4/5); the lead-in sentences u383 and u967 and band titles u382/u966 are band-level standards.

Grade 6, 7, 8 are grade-level (course null) even though each has a thematic title (Grade 6 Alaska Studies and Geography; Grade 7 World History and Geography; Grade 8 U.S. History and Civics). Grades 9-12 discipline sections (Civics, Economics, Geography, Alaska History, U.S. History, World History) were treated as courses per the state guide, course = discipline name from the section title ('Grade 9 through 12 Civics Standards' -> 'Civics'); the section headings u2629, u2691, u2743, u2787, u3154, u3624 are labeled with that course.

u2788-u2800 (Alaska History time periods and timeframes table) labeled standards, course 'Alaska History' (course-level organizing framework, analogous to grade themes); could alternatively be considered examples/backup.

Page 74 (u1896-u1898) header row is merged into three cells ('The student demonstrates Content Standard', 'Topic an understanding of... Therefore, the student is able to...'); labeled backup. u1899 is the Topic cell ('Local, Tribal, and State Governments'), labeled standards.

Page 114-125 tables (U.S. History theme 1 and World History theme 1: u3157-u3186, u3627-u3667) are shifted one column right (Topic in C2, anchor in C3, standards in C4); handled by cell text, grades unaffected. u3166 ('Alaska Government') and u3646 ('14') are continuation fragments of anchor labels; labeled standards.

Source code oddities (not corrected, labels unaffected): SS.8.1.16.1 appears twice in Grade 8 (u2127, u2154); SS.8.8.21.1 twice (u2522, u2530); SS.8.7.4.1 listed under History Anchor 24 (u2472); SS.USH.23.9.1 (u3198) and SS.USH.17.9.1 (u3209) have malformed codes; Grade 8 topic 'Civic Participation' (u2214) is attached to a History Anchor 24 row; Grade 7 topic u1922 reads 'Prehistory (formerly human environment interaction)'; Grade 7 u2084 etc. topic 'Conquest and Conquer' as written.

State guide notes verified: K-2/3-5 leveled structure, 6/7/8 themed grades, 9-12 discipline sections all match the document. The guide's 'Grade 6 through 8 Inquiry Standards' applies to 6-8 confirmed. Front matter u1-u380 (including sample standards on pp. 19-20 and anchor-standard definition tables on pp. 12-19, whose extraction is fragmented, e.g. u159-u262) is entirely backup.
